# [STORY] As a maintainer, I want epic #39 and everything under it audited, so that "Event-Driven Analytics with Kafka" is accurate and test-backed

## User Story
**As a** maintainer
**I want** epic #39 and every story and task under it audited
**So that** "Event-Driven Analytics with Kafka" describes what was actually built, and every criterion is backed by a test or a re-runnable command

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given epic #39, when audited in epic mode, then it matches the epic template, meets the writing standard, and its native sub-issue links are complete and correct (epic #39 body rewritten: dropped the stale `## Status` section and the `## References` section, folded the ADR/ARCHITECTURE.md pointers into `## Notes`; sub-issue links are exactly #96, #97, #98, nothing more)
- [x] Given story #96 and its 2 tasks, when its audit task below is done, then every one of them has been through the four gates (#282)
- [x] Given story #97 and its 2 tasks, when its audit task below is done, then every one of them has been through the four gates (#283)
- [x] Given story #98 and its 2 tasks, when its audit task below is done, then every one of them has been through the four gates (#284)
- [x] Given every criterion in this subtree, when it is read, then it names a test, a CI step, or a re-runnable command, and none closes on a date (verified by hand: every criterion on #96, #97, #98, #40, #41, #42, #43, #44, #45 names a test class/method, a Gradle command, or an explicit `(manual: ...)`/`(no test — ...)`; the named test classes and methods exist in the repo)
- [x] Given every issue in this subtree, when its metadata is read, then it has one type label, one priority label, no `sprint-N` label, and a correct native parent link (epic #39: `epic` + `P2-medium`; stories #96/#97/#98: `user-story` + `P2-medium`; tasks #40-#45: `task` + `P2-medium`; no `sprint-N` label anywhere; every task's native parent points to its story, every story's to #39)
- [x] Given every child story is audited, when epic #39 is checked, then it is closed if all its stories are closed, and left open otherwise (epic #39 is closed; all 3 stories closed)
